fields.value: Protecting your voice, safeguarding your vote, and ensuring elections remain fair, secure, and accessible
fields.quote: The Secretary of State’s job is about protecting your voice, safeguarding your vote, and ensuring our elections remain fair, secure, and accessible.

fields.value: Restore trust in our elections, protect your personal data, and make sure government is accountable to the people it serves
fields.quote: I’m running to restore trust in our elections, protect your personal data, and make sure government is accountable to the people it serves.

fields.value: Ensure government is accountable so voters can demand action on affordability, rising costs, and the issues that matter most
fields.quote: I’ve worked to ensure government is accountable to the people so voters can demand action on affordability, rising costs, and the issues that matter most.
